name: Messenger Support
description: Display an embedded Messenger chat window and an optional Facebook link on the customer dashboard.
author: ZaoGuang Service

page_username.label: Facebook Page username
page_username.description: Enter the Page username from the end of its m.me link, not the full URL.

page_id.label: Facebook Page ID
page_id.description: Numeric Page ID enables the embedded Messenger chat. Add your domain to the Page's allowlist in Meta Business settings.
